### 4.1 Geographical Scope
The engagement covers Google Silicon COT Supply Chain operations for the in-scope manufacturing and distribution network spanning Taiwan and North America. Country and site coverage includes TSMC, KYEC, and SPIL in Taiwan, together with the Google Hub and Warehouse locations supporting the operating model. Delivery will be performed through a blended onsite and offshore model, with onsite coverage in North America and offshore delivery aligned to the agreed project workstreams.

### 4.2 Process Scope
Process scope includes end-to-end Customer Owned Tooling (COT) supply chain processes required to support constrained supply planning and execution for the Silicon business unit. In-scope processes include AS-IS assessment, fit-gap analysis, TO-BE process design, production planning, materials management, subcontracting-related planning and transaction flows, batch and lot traceability, material master alignment, supply and capacity collaboration inputs, yield-related planning inputs, and downstream analytics and reporting design. The scope also includes enterprise structure and process harmonization needed to establish a global template with local operational considerations for foundry, OSAT, manufacturing, and distribution operations.

### 4.3 Technical Scope
Technical scope includes implementation and configuration activities for SAP S/4HANA and Kinaxis, plus boundary-system integration design and build required for the target Silicon planning model. In-scope technical work covers SAP S/4HANA PP and MM, Kinaxis supply planning capabilities, retained use of Google’s existing integration framework for machine planning where applicable, adaptation of existing data templates for Silicon planning needs, and incremental delta interfaces identified during discovery. Integration design and delivery include BTP-IS-based delta integration between S/4HANA and E2Open, SAP-to-Kinaxis data exchanges, and validation of interfaces with PLM, BigQuery, MES, and Test Hub within agreed system boundaries. Controlling (CO) support remains with Google.

### 4.4 Services Scope
Services in scope include project management, project initiation support, fit-gap analysis, AS-IS discovery, TO-BE process design, business process documentation, functional specifications for approved custom development, configuration and build, integration design and delivery, test planning and execution, unit testing, system integration testing, UAT support, regression testing, performance testing, data migration support, cutover planning, deployment support, hypercare, organization change management, train-the-trainer activities, and knowledge transfer to the support team. Delivery will follow a phased Agile model across Explore, Build, and Deploy.

### 4.5 Application Scope
Application scope includes SAP S/4HANA, Kinaxis, and E2Open as the primary solution landscape for this engagement. Within Kinaxis, in-scope functionality includes Supply Planning, Constraint Planning, Inventory Planning, Analytics and Reporting, and Data Integration. Within SAP S/4HANA, in-scope functionality includes Production Planning (PP), Materials Management (MM), and process integration required to support the Silicon COT supply chain model. Application interactions with PLM (Agile), BigQuery, MES, and Test Hub are included where required to support approved interface, traceability, planning, and analytics use cases.

### 4.6 Integration Scope
| # | Integration | Source System | Target System | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Supply collaboration integration | E2Open | SAP S/4HANA | Supports PO, forecast, and commit flows for TSMC and OSAT partners |
| 2 | Planning signal integration | SAP S/4HANA | Kinaxis | Includes demand signals, WIP snapshots, and wafer plan data |
| 3 | Capacity and CM data ingestion | E2Open | Kinaxis | Includes inbound capacity and CM data for TSMC, KYEC, and SPIL |
| 4 | Design and engineering integration | PLM (Agile) | SAP S/4HANA | Design BOM and engineering change integration to be validated during discovery |
| 5 | Analytics and reporting integration | SAP S/4HANA | BigQuery | Supports cost, yield, and analytics through the Silicon Hub |
| 6 | Resource, yield, and UOM integration | <CONFIRM: source systems for resource master, yield, and UOM feeds> | Kinaxis | Build required integrations to support planning model readiness |
| 7 | Test and manufacturing boundary integration | MES / Test Hub | SAP S/4HANA / Kinaxis | Limited to agreed planning and traceability boundaries; unit-level test boundary only |
| 8 | Delta integration framework | Existing Google integration framework / BTP-IS | SAP S/4HANA, E2Open, Kinaxis | Existing framework will be leveraged; incremental delta interfaces are in scope |

### 4.7 Exclusions
- SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) configuration, build, and staffing are excluded from Bristlecone scope and remain with Google.
- New replacement of Google’s existing integration framework is excluded; the engagement will leverage and extend the existing framework where applicable.
- Full MES and Test Hub implementation beyond agreed planning and interface boundaries is excluded.
- Unit-level manufacturing or test data management outside the stated test boundary is excluded.
- Application support services beyond the defined hypercare period are excluded unless separately agreed.
- Business operations ownership, final business approvals, and source-data accuracy remediation remain Google responsibilities.
- Any integrations, plants, processes, or functional areas not expressly identified in this section are excluded unless added through approved change control.
